subject: Azure PartnerCenter: account wiring + seller ownership closure for Contoso
messages:
From: Aimee Clarke <aimee.clarke@microsoft.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 2, 2028 at 09:15 AM -0700
Subject: PartnerCenter referral: Contoso ownership ambiguity

Marissa / team —

Thanks for taking this on. Contoso has a set of contested accounts in Partner Center: three accounts are currently flagged as "shadow" (field seller unassigned) and two show both a marketplace seller and an enterprise field owner. This mismatch is causing delays on the co-sell referral acceptance and is holding up the incentives.

I attached the account map and a brief export from Partner Center with the referral timestamps. Quick asks: can Redwood confirm who your recommended owner is for the two contested enterprise accounts (Contoso Corp HQ and Contoso Cloud Ops)? Also, would you be able to confirm a primary/secondary seller for the entire Contoso estate so Microsoft can finalize co-sell routing?

Suggested timeline: 48-hour owner confirmation, then we (MS) re-run the referral acceptance process on our side. If useful, loop in Ben for any orphan-account cleanup logic on your end.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Aimee
Aimee Clarke
Senior PM, Partner Sales (Azure)
Microsoft Corporation

Attachments: contoso_account_map.xlsx, pc-referral-history-Contoso.pdf

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aimee Clarke <aimee.clarke@microsoft.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 2, 2028 at 11:03 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: PartnerCenter referral: Contoso ownership ambiguity

Aimee — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. We pulled the export and ran an initial reconciliation. High level: the marketplace listing referral generated a secondary "marketplace seller" owner tag for two accounts where our field team already had active opportunities. That's the root of the duplicate-owner flag.

Action plan (proposed):
- Marissa (me): validate opportunity ownership with Contoso contacts for the two contested accounts (Contoso Corp HQ, Contoso Cloud Ops). I’ll confirm CRM owner ids and hubspot deal links.
- Vanessa: run the orphan-account sweep to identify any accounts without a field seller and flag them for claim.
- Karthik: once we confirm owners, apply PartnerCenter owner override request form and notify MS. If MS needs a POA/DocuSign, we can provide.
- Ben: help with any canonicalization of account ids where Contoso has duplicate tenant records.

Can everyone confirm they can action within 48 hours? If so, I’ll reach out to Contoso to lock in owner confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 2, 2028 at 13:40 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: PartnerCenter referral: Contoso ownership ambiguity

Agree with the plan — I’ll start the orphan sweep now. Quick note on heuristics: look for tenant_id mismatch + last_contacted > 180 days as primary signals for orphan. I’ll produce a short CSV with candidate claims and the suggested owner (based on latest opportunity owner).

Ben — can you pre-validate the duplicate tenant merge keys so we don’t submit conflicting overrides to MS? I’ll attach the initial claim CSV to the drive link and ping Aimee once we have a clean list.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, Apr 3, 2028 at 08:22 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: PartnerCenter referral: Contoso ownership ambiguity

On Tue, Apr 2, 2028 at 1:40 PM vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Agree with the plan — I’ll start the orphan sweep now. Quick note on heuristics: look for tenant_id mismatch + last_contacted > 180 days as primary signals for orphan. I’ll produce a short CSV with candidate claims and the suggested owner (based on latest opportunity owner).

Thanks — I pulled the Contoso tenant list and ran the merge-key check. There are two duplicate tenant records for "Contoso Cloud Ops" that share an email namespace but different tenant_ids. I’ll canonicalize to the tenant_id that has the active opportunity (oppty id 987654) and flag the other as shadow. I’ll also add a mapping column for Partner Center owner_override submission.

ETA: I’ll push the cleaned mapping to the shared Drive by EOD today and tag Aimee for MS re-ingestion.

Ben Carter
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aimee Clarke <aimee.clarke@microsoft.com>, Luis Ramirez <luis.ramirez@contoso.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, Apr 4, 2028 at 16:22 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: PartnerCenter referral: Contoso ownership ambiguity — ownership confirmed

Aimee / Luis — quick update and next steps.

1) Ownership confirmed: Contoso validated primary owners for the two contested accounts via Luis (see inline confirmations). Primary owner = Sarah Patel (Enterprise Sales) for Contoso Corp HQ; Primary owner = Miguel Ortega (Cloud Architect) for Contoso Cloud Ops.

2) Canonicalization complete: Ben finished the tenant_id canonicalization and uploaded the cleaned account map to the shared Drive (link below). Vanessa produced the claim CSV for 12 orphan accounts and marked suggested owners.

3) Submission to Partner Center: Karthik will submit owner_override requests and include the DocuSign POA token if MS requires it. Aimee, can you confirm your preferred stub/format for Partner Center override submissions so we match MS expectations? We can template the payload and have it ready for re-ingest tomorrow.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/Contoso/PartnerCenter/ownership-matrix
DocuSign: DocuSign: 0XkY-Contoso-POA
Attached: contoso_account_map.xlsx, pc-referral-history-Contoso.pdf

If you want a short sync, happy to jump on a 15-min call tomorrow morning to confirm submission values — otherwise we’ll submit and ping you when MS has re-ingested.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

—Marissa
